items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I told him Kid Nick. We had Keon Cornette. I was on trombone. Israel Garment used to play clarinet. A fellow by the name of Lucky used to live up in Carrollton. He used to play bass.

ctx.x: I told him Kid Nick. We had Keon Cornette. I was on trombone. Israel Garment used to play clarinet. A fellow by the name of Lucky used to live up in Carrollton. He used to play bass. Arthur Roden. Arthur Roden. . . .

You were talking about Wooden Joe. I'm not sure we got all of the men on. The drummer, who was the drummer with Wooden Joe? Arthur Hogan. Oh yes. And the banjo? John Smith. I think we got the others. Did you mention any bass player? Yeah, we used to call him Buddy Lux. I forget his right name, but we used to call him Buddy Lux.
